# Cozelos Data

> Premium digital agency in Vernal, Utah. We build custom websites, SEO, video, online marketing, branding, and business automation for local and government clients.

## About
Cozelos Data is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) digital agency headquartered in Vernal, Utah. We build cinematic, fast, search-optimized websites and the marketing systems that make them work. Clients own everything we build — domain, hosting, code, and content.

- Phone: (435) 219-5120
- Email: ellen.cozelos@cozelosdata.com
- Location: 431 East Main St. Suite 201, Vernal, UT 84078
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM MT

## Services
- Website Design & Development: Custom, mobile-first, sub-second websites. Projects start at $2,500.
- SEO Optimization: Pillar-and-spoke architecture, JSON-LD schema, AI search optimization.
- Video Production: 4K aerial drone footage, on-location filming, cinematic color grading.
- Online Marketing: Meta & Google Ads, conversion tracking, landing pages, monthly reporting.
- Business Automation: AI assistants, scheduling, CRM integration, workflow automation.
- Ongoing Support: Monthly growth plans from $295/month — maintenance, security, SEO, and marketing.

## Government Contracting
WOSB-eligible. DUNS 059220399. CAGE 897W0. NAICS 513210, 541511 (primary), 541512, 541513. Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA accessible. Capability statement available on request.
